capabilities.target: enrich.lookup third-party enrichment API, billed against a shared monthly quota
Researcher sub-agent instance spawned to investigate an account
CRM account record enriched fields (industry, size, headquarters)

inputs.source: Nightly batch of CRM account rows
enrich.lookup API response content, used by the agent to judge completeness

instructions.note: 'Keep going until every row is complete' has no exit condition. Runtime notes confirm roughly 3 percent of the 40,000 nightly rows (about 1,200) have malformed names that never return a complete result, guaranteeing indefinite retries and spawns every night.
'If a lookup fails or looks incomplete' gives the model open-ended discretion over when to retry versus delegate to a sub-agent, with no defined completeness criteria.

elements.name: Shared enrichment API key and monthly quota
Sales and marketing tools dependent on the shared enrichment quota

controls.name: Dedicated enrichment quota/key, separate from the shared sales/marketing key
controls.decay_rationale: A separately scoped credential and quota means runaway consumption by this agent cannot affect other teams' tools, regardless of model behavior.

controls.name: Hard per-run and per-day spend cap on cap.enrich_lookup
controls.decay_rationale: Enforced at the API gateway or billing layer, outside the model's control.

controls.name: Max steps, max runtime, and max retries per row for the batch run
controls.decay_rationale: An orchestration-level ceiling does not depend on the model choosing to stop.

controls.name: Disallow recursive sub-agent spawning; cap spawn depth and count
controls.decay_rationale: Enforced by the orchestrator refusing further delegate calls past a fixed depth/count, independent of model behavior.

controls.name: Real-time spend/quota alert with automatic circuit breaker
controls.decay_rationale: Monitoring and auto-halt logic sit outside the model and fire on observed spend regardless of model intent.

controls.name: Schema validation/sanitization of enrich.lookup responses before they drive retries, delegation, or CRM writes
controls.decay_rationale: Structural checks catch malformed structure, but free-text fields in the API response still require semantic judgment, which a more capable or adversarial response can get past.

controls.name: Prompt instruction capping retries per row and marking unresolved rows instead of 'keep going until complete'
controls.decay_rationale: Relies on the model choosing to stop; a more capable or more literally-instruction-following model may still rationalize continued retries.

findings.title: TC6 spend loop: unbounded enrich.lookup calls exhaust the shared enrichment quota and deny service to sales/marketing

attack_path.note: Nightly batch feeds all 40,000 account rows into the enrichment loop.
Agent calls the billed API per row, retrying indefinitely per prompt.md:2-3 with no cap; ~3 percent of rows never complete.
Each call consumes the monthly quota shared with sales and marketing.
Quota exhaustion stops sales and marketing tools from working until the next month.

forecast.watch_signal: Shared quota consumption rate sustained near the ceiling on successive nights, or new teams/tools added onto the same enrichment key.

evidence.observation: 'There is no maximum on steps, runtime, retries, or sub agents' confirms no bound on repeated enrich.lookup calls.

'enrich.lookup is billed per call. The API key and its monthly quota are shared with the sales and marketing teams; when the quota runs out, their tools stop working until the next month' establishes the S3 spend sink and the cross-team blast radius.

'Roughly 3 percent of rows have malformed company names that never return a complete result' combined with prompt.md:3 'Keep going until every row is complete' guarantees an unbounded retry loop on about 1,200 of the 40,000 nightly rows.
'There is no spend alert on the enrichment account' confirms the absence of any detective control.

recommendations.action: Give the enrichment agent its own API key and quota, separate from the shared sales/marketing key, so runaway consumption cannot cause cross-team denial of service.
Enforce a hard per-run and per-day spend cap on cap.enrich_lookup at the API gateway or billing layer.
Set max_unattended_steps and max_runtime_minutes for the batch job, and cap retries per row (e.g., 2) with automatic fallback to a 'needs manual review' status.
Add real-time spend/quota alerting with an automatic circuit breaker that halts the batch when spend crosses a threshold.

findings.title: TC6 variant: unbounded recursive sub-agent spawning multiplies spend and compounds the quota exhaustion

attack_path.note: Every account row can trigger a delegation decision.
Agent spawns a researcher sub-agent per incomplete row, per prompt.md:2-3, with no bound.
Runtime notes confirm each researcher can itself spawn further researchers, with no depth or count limit.
Every spawned researcher independently calls the billed enrich.lookup API, multiplying spend against the shared quota.

forecast.watch_signal: Growing average sub-agents spawned per batch, or sub-agent nesting depth observed beyond 1.

evidence.observation: '...spawn a researcher sub agent to investigate the account. Keep going until every row is complete' authorizes unbounded delegation with no exit condition.
'Sub agents can spawn their own researchers' confirms unbounded recursive fan-out with no declared depth or count limit.

recommendations.action: Disable recursive spawning (researchers may not spawn further researchers) or cap spawn depth to 1 and total concurrent sub-agents per batch to a fixed number, enforced in the orchestration layer.
Require each spawned researcher to inherit the same step/spend budget ceiling as the parent run rather than an independent budget.

findings.title: ASI01 goal hijack: unvalidated enrich.lookup output drives retry/delegation decisions and flows into CRM writes

attack_path.note: Agent calls the external, untrusted enrich.lookup API.
The untrusted API response content determines whether the result 'looks incomplete.'
Based on that untrusted content, the agent decides to delegate to a new researcher sub-agent.
Enrichment data derived from untrusted, unvalidated API responses is eventually written into CRM records with no review step described.

forecast.watch_signal: Any observed case where a lookup response's wording, rather than a defined field-completeness check, visibly changes the retry/spawn decision.

evidence.observation: 'If a lookup fails or looks incomplete, retry, or spawn a researcher sub agent to investigate the account' means the decision to retry or delegate is driven by the content/shape of the untrusted enrich.lookup response, with no validation step described anywhere in the artifacts.
No schema validation, spotlighting, or output classifier for enrich.lookup responses is mentioned anywhere in the runtime notes.

recommendations.action: Validate enrich.lookup responses against a fixed schema before using them to decide whether to retry or spawn; treat free-text content as data only, never as a trigger for new tool calls.

Replace the open-ended 'if a lookup fails or looks incomplete' judgment with an explicit, field-level completeness check (industry/size/headquarters non-null) so the retry/spawn decision is deterministic, not model-interpreted.
Flag enriched CRM fields written from retried or researcher-sourced lookups for periodic human QA sampling.

rating.rationale: All three findings reach the top-left cell of the base matrix (an internal or untrusted source against an S3 sink: spend, delegate, or a chain ending in one of those) and the autonomy modifier applies to every one of them, because autonomy is A4_fully_autonomous with can_spawn_agents true and no step or runtime ceiling (max_unattended_steps and max_runtime_minutes are both null). Inherent risk is therefore already critical for each finding. No preventive, containment, or detective control exists anywhere in the design: there is no spend cap, no step or retry limit, no spawn-depth limit, no output validation on the untrusted enrich.lookup response, and no spend alert. None of the rubric's control-credit steps apply, so residual risk equals inherent risk at critical for every finding. Because residual is already at the ceiling and there are no active controls left to decay, the forecast cannot rise further under any trigger and stays critical; the risk does not need a future capability jump to be severe; it is already fully realized by the declared design. The single highest-value intervention is pairing a dedicated, separately-scoped enrichment quota (which would sever the cross-team denial-of-service path) with a hard per-run spend cap and a spawn-depth/count limit; together these should be treated as p1 and implemented before the next nightly run.

limitations: This assessment reflects declared design and configuration as described in prompt.md and the runtime notes, not observed runtime behavior.

No formal orchestration configuration, IaC, or tool manifest was provided; autonomy limits, credential scoping for cap.crm_write, and the sub-agent's exact capability surface are inferred from prose runtime notes and marked with reduced confidence where relevant (for example, cap.crm_write's credential_scope is recorded as unknown).

The spawned researcher sub-agent has no formally defined agent_id or card in the artifacts; it is represented as a generic process element (proc.researcher_subagent) rather than assessed as its own subject.

No sample enrich.lookup response payloads were provided, so the goal-hijack finding (find.untrusted_output_goal_hijack) is inferred from the prompt's conditional wording rather than observed tool output content; confidence is marked medium accordingly.
